falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on volatility compression and orderly decline; a vol spike above 35 indicates panic selling and capitulation, breaking the pattern structure and invalidating the gradual bottom thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts deeper than -75bps (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The pattern assumed stabilizing financial conditions; a sharp curve flattening/inversion signals credit stress and recession acceleration, proving the macro backdrop has deteriorated beyond the pattern's parameters

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This breaks the August 2024 low of ~4,200 and violates the structural support level that defined the pattern's floor; a breach confirms this is not a repeat bottom but a continuation lower

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
